content.title: Whoop Is Considering Going Public in the Next Two Years, CEO Says
content.summary: Founder and Chief Executive Officer Will Ahmed said the business is well-positioned for an IPO now that it’s broadened its portfolio to include proprietary technology, hardware, software, analytics and other items, such as accessories and apparel.  While Ahmed has previously said Whoop is likely to go public, he hadn’t shared when that might happen.  “We like to build things ourselves and we really want to build this home of health for our members,” he added.
